note_en: Hib vaccine would prevent a substantial share of meningitis and under-5 deaths (Lombok probe study)
note_zh: Hib疫苗可预防相当部分脑膜炎和5岁以下死亡（龙目岛探针研究）

note_en: Carriage linked to household crowding; no factor of this study tested
note_zh: 携带与家中多名幼儿相关；未检验本研究因素

note_en: Piped water and community sanitation associated; household sanitation not
note_zh: 管道水与社区卫生设施相关，家庭卫生设施无关联

note_en: Unsafe disposal associated; facility type itself not
note_zh: 不安全处置相关，设施类型本身无关联

note_en: Shared toilet aOR 1.45 (2022 national nutrition survey)
note_zh: 共用厕所 aOR 1.45（2022年全国营养调查）

note_en: 13.9% of under-5 deaths in 2012 attributable to unsafe WASH; rural provinces worst
note_zh: 2012年5岁以下死亡的13.9%归因于不安全WASH；农村省份最重

note_en: Assessed microbial quality of supplies meeting standards, not access to a basic service; pathogens at compliant levels were judged not the main cause of under-5 deaths
note_zh: 评估的是达标供水的微生物水质，而非基本饮水服务的可及；认为合规水平下的水中病原体不是5岁以下死亡的主因

flag_zh: 生长迟缓 −11.6；低出生体重 −6.8；疫苗
fac_zh: 营养不良；母亲吸烟；母亲HIV
note_en: Malnutrition associated; maternal HIV is outside the factor set
note_zh: 营养不良相关；母亲HIV不在本研究因素内

note_en: Severe pneumococcal cases and deaths fell after PCV; HIV care also contributed
note_zh: PCV引入后严重肺炎球菌病例和死亡下降；HIV治疗亦有作用

note_en: In-house biomass cooking OR 2.30 for ARI symptoms
note_zh: 室内生物质烹饪与急性呼吸道感染症状 OR 2.30

note_en: 7 of 11 Hib cases unvaccinated; meningococcus outside the factor set
note_zh: 11例Hib中7例未接种；脑膜炎球菌不在因素内

note_en: Wide regional variation
note_zh: 地区差异大

note_en: Respiratory admissions <15 years rose 1.76% per 10 µg/m³; indirect (age and outcome differ)
note_zh: <15岁呼吸系统住院每10 µg/m³升高1.76%；间接（年龄与结局不同）

note_en: Paediatric pneumonia ED visits rose 14.0% per IQR of PM2.5
note_zh: 儿童肺炎急诊每IQR PM2.5增加14.0%

note_en: Bronchitis <2 years RR 1.30 per 25 µg/m³
note_zh: <2岁支气管炎每25 µg/m³ RR 1.30

note_en: Field LRI incidence high, contrary to the GBD-based low tail for incidence
note_zh: 实地LRI发病高，与基于GBD的发病低尾相反

note_en: Overflowing latrines and stored water associated; not breastfeeding outside the factor set (conference abstract)
note_zh: 厕所满溢和储水相关；未母乳喂养不在因素内（会议摘要）

rec_zh: 腹泻病（发病高尾、死亡低尾）
note_en: Aboriginal infants hospitalised for gastroenteritis about 8 times as often
note_zh: 原住民婴儿胃肠炎住院约为非原住民的8倍

note_en: Hib meningitis fell from 92 to 16 per 100 000 infants within a year
note_zh: 一年内Hib脑膜炎由92降至16/10万婴儿

note_en: Infant pneumonia admissions and mortality fell after PCV13; indirect (pneumonia, not meningitis)
note_zh: PCV13后婴儿肺炎住院与死亡下降；间接（结局为肺炎）

note_en: High local prevalence; WASH not significantly associated; illustrates incidence–mortality separation
note_zh: 局部患病率高，WASH未显著关联；发病—死亡分离的实例

note_en: Weather explained an extra 15% of variation in RSV transmissibility
note_zh: 气象再解释RSV传播力15%的变异

note_en: ORT use rose from 13% to 46% (MICS 2000–2011)
note_zh: ORT使用由13%升至46%（MICS 2000—2011年）

note_en: Rising PCV coverage with falling admissions; Spain’s vaccine status not classed favourable
note_zh: PCV覆盖上升与住院下降相关；西班牙疫苗状态未判为明确有利

note_en: Winter PM2.5 about 6 times WHO limit; no child-specific data
note_zh: 冬季PM2.5约为WHO限值6倍；无儿童数据

note_en: Solid fuel use associated with ARI in girls (OR 3.28) but not boys; CHNS 2004–2011, ages <18 years
note_zh: 固体燃料使用与女孩急性呼吸道感染相关（OR 3.28），与男孩无关；CHNS 2004—2011年，<18岁

note_en: RSV in 45.7% of bronchiolitis admissions <2 years, with year-round cases in a hot desert climate
note_zh: <2岁毛细支气管炎住院中RSV占45.7%，炎热沙漠气候下全年发病

note_en: Respiratory morbidity rose after PM2.5 exposure (lag 0–2 days), highest at ages 0–14; Jeddah, hospital visits (age and outcome differ)
note_zh: PM2.5暴露后0—2天呼吸系统就诊增加，0—14岁最高；吉达，医院就诊（年龄与结局不同）

note_en: Diarrhoea prevalence 56.3% under 2 years, exclusive breastfeeding 15.9%; factors of this study not tested
note_zh: <2岁腹泻患病率56.3%，纯母乳喂养15.9%；未检验本研究因素

note_en: Adding PM2.5, PM10 and NO2 raised explained variance in child RSV admissions from 23% to 31% (outcome differs)
note_zh: 加入PM2.5、PM10和NO2后，儿童RSV住院的解释变异由23%升至31%（结局不同）

note_en: All-cause pneumonia admissions <2 years fell 24.6% after universal PCV10 from 2017 (two regional hospitals)
note_zh: 2017年起全民接种PCV10后，<2岁全因肺炎住院下降24.6%（两家地区医院）
